WITH RECURSIVE dcr_tree( dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_company_id, dcr01_class_tree_nm, dcr01_parent_tree_id, dcr01_seq, dcr01_note, dcr01_class_tree_cd, dcr01_type_cd, dcr01_use_yn, dcr01_admin_yn, depth, path, cycle ) AS ( SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_company_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_seq, a.dcr01_note, a.dcr01_class_tree_cd, a.dcr01_type_cd, a.dcr01_use_yn, a.dcr01_admin_yn, 1, ARRAY[CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar),10,'0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a.dcr01_class_tree_id], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = 0 AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{typeCode} UNION ALL SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_company_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_seq, a.dcr01_note, a.dcr01_class_tree_cd, a.dcr01_type_cd, a.dcr01_use_yn, a.dcr01_admin_yn, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar),10,'0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a.dcr01_class_tree_id), a.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a INNER JOIN dcr_tree b ON a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{typeCode} AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, a.dcr01_company_id AS company_id, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, a.dcr01_class_tree_cd AS class_tree_code, a.dcr01_seq AS seq, a.dcr01_note AS note, a.dcr01_type_cd AS type_code, COALESCE(a.dcr01_use_yn, 'false') AS use_yn, COALESCE(a.dcr01_admin_yn, 'false') AS admin_yn, a.depth - 1 AS depth FROM dcr_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_type_cd IN ('T','C') ORDER BY a.path

WITH RECURSIVE dcr_tree( dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_company_id, dcr01_class_tree_nm, dcr01_parent_tree_id, dcr01_seq, dcr01_class_tree_cd, dcr01_type_cd, dcr01_use_yn, depth, path, cycle ) AS ( SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_company_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_seq, a.dcr01_class_tree_cd, a.dcr01_type_cd, a.dcr01_use_yn, 1, ARRAY[CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar),10,'0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS varchar),15,'0')], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = 0 AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{typeCode} UNION ALL SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_company_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_seq, a.dcr01_class_tree_cd, a.dcr01_type_cd, a.dcr01_use_yn, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar),10,'0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS varchar),15,'0')), a.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a INNER JOIN dcr_tree b ON a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{typeCode} AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, a.dcr01_type_cd AS type_code, COALESCE(a.dcr01_use_yn, 'false') AS use_yn, CASE WHEN a.dcr01_type_cd = 'T' THEN COALESCE(apr.apr_count, 0) ELSE NULL END AS appr_count, a.depth - 1 AS depth FROM dcr_tree a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT apr01_class_tree_id, COUNT(*) AS apr_count FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY apr01_class_tree_id ) apr ON apr.apr01_class_tree_id = a.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_type_cd IN ('T','C') ORDER BY a.path
